text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Oh man, how did this happen? There's
no
doubt... I've gained weight!)

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for lending a hand, Kita! Here,
have a
sweet steamed bun for the road!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure I can have this? Yay, thank
you!

text_block_list.name: Lady A
text_block_list.text:
You helped me out a bunch, little lady! I
don't
suppose these are the best of
gifts, but please
have these rice crackers
as thanks!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You're welcome! And thanks for the
snack!

text_block_list.name: Older Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Hey, Kita! Here, want some candy? ♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's thoughtfulness made me so
happy, I
ended up accepting everything
they gave me,
but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'll have to start refusing snacks. I'll just
accept
their feelings of gratitude
instead!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following this revelation, Kitasan Black

reluctantly declines everyone's offer of
snacks
and successfully gets back in
shape.
